desc:
Step into Glamour League Simulator on Roblox! Team up with friends to run your own cosmetics store—stock shelves, operate the cash register, and serve customers. Earn coins to expand your shop and become the top beauty destination! 💄✨

💸Code: 2026GRANDOPEN
👍NEW CODE releases once the game gets 800 LIKES

Thank you for playing! If you find any bugs or problems, feel free to give us feedback at: https://www.roblox.com/communities/975412966/BlueCoreStudio#!/forums/feedback-9cacda2b
We really appreciate your help.
